action_summary: Restored the proven v52 inference configuration, which holds the best leaderboard score (0.81978): the predict_exp302.py call now points at the exp301-1-large-itpt10-f0 config and its single model_fold0.pth checkpoint with deberta-v3-large, replacing the v54 four-fold exp301-1-large-itpt10-all set that regressed to 0.80482. Because the exact v52 thresholds are not recorded and the v54 set has an outlying 3/4 cutpoint (3.357), the rounding thresholds were replaced by a balanced set, the mean of the two fitted threshold sets present in the notebook ([1.643, 2.554, 3.415, 4.401, 5.135]). Also clipped the rounded scores to 1..6 and cast to int so the submission is always valid. Rest of the pipeline and Kaggle paths unchanged.
